title: Split to stay under the approval limit
transcript:
Ray Kim (Kim Roofing): The full job is $1,800.
Rosa Delgado (owner): My card limit for one payment is $1,000, so that needs my partner's sign-off.
Ray Kim (Kim Roofing): Easy fix, just send two payments of $900 so it stays under the limit.
Rosa Delgado (owner): Fine, I'll pay Kim Roofing $900 today and $900 tomorrow.

traps.description: The payment is split into two $900 halves to avoid a $1,000 sign-off rule.

note: Pre-registered prediction: the checker reads what was said, not company policy, so it is likely to prove both $900 drafts. This meeting is kept in the set anyway as an honest test of that limit.
